systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
systems.tiers: design stage: village Local Council (LC1) chairpersons, a registry of over 70,000, to issue digitally signed letters verified against NIRA and the Electoral Commission, with QR-coded printouts for low-connectivity areas

note: The ministry's account of a design-stage system for village council letters, presented at a summit on 4 to 6 November 2025; it states no connection of any local government office.
